security.ssh.version.explanation: Forces Cisco IOS/IOS-XE to negotiate only SSHv2 and closes vulnerabilities associated with SSHv1 fallback.

security.telnet.enabled.explanation: Restricts virtual terminal lines exclusively to SSH and eliminates cleartext Telnet access.

security.http_server.enabled.explanation: Disables unencrypted HTTP management daemon and enables TLS-encrypted HTTPS management.

security.https_server.enabled.verification_cmd: show ip http server secure status
security.https_server.enabled.explanation: Enables HTTPS secure web management daemon.

security.password_policy.min_length.explanation: Enforces a global minimum password length of 14 characters on Cisco IOS devices.

security.session_timeout.explanation: Configures terminal inactive session timeout to 5 minutes (300 seconds).

security.banner.login_banner_configured.explanation: Configures legal advisory login notice before authentication.

security.ntp.configured.explanation: Synchronizes system clocks with an authoritative time server.

cli_commands: snmp-server user secadmin SECUREGROUP v3 auth sha <AUTH_SECRET> priv aes 128 <PRIV_SECRET>
security.snmp.v3_only.explanation: Removes legacy SNMPv1/v2c communities and enables SNMPv3 authentication and privacy.

security.aaa.authentication_login.explanation: Enforces centralized AAA architecture for administrator access.

security.ftp.disabled.explanation: Disables cleartext FTP server daemon on Cisco IOS devices.

security.aux_port.disabled.explanation: Disables execution and transport access on the auxiliary console port.

security.password_policy.encryption_serv.explanation: Enables local password hash encryption service for stored credentials.

security.password_policy.login_lockout.explanation: Configures brute force login rate limiting and lockout delay.

security.ip.redirects_disabled.verification_cmd: show ip interface GigabitEthernet0/0 | include redirects
security.ip.redirects_disabled.explanation: Disables ICMP redirects on routed interfaces.

security.ip.directed_broadcast_disabled.verification_cmd: show ip interface GigabitEthernet0/0 | include directed-broadcast
security.ip.directed_broadcast_disabled.explanation: Disables directed broadcasts to prevent network amplification attacks.

security.ip.proxy_arp_disabled.verification_cmd: show ip interface GigabitEthernet0/0 | include Proxy ARP

security.control_plane.copp_enabled.explanation: Applies Control Plane Policing (CoPP) to protect the route processor CPU.
